description: Under the antigravity lens the slash extractor runs over every node body, so `/name` invocations resolve across BOTH kinds via the provider's `invokes: ['skill', 'workflow']` matrix: a workflow's `/run-tests` and `/changelog-entry` resolve to skills, a workflow's `/deploy` resolves to another workflow, and AGENTS.md's `/deploy` (a core/markdown node) resolves to the deploy workflow too. Together with the markdown links to the docs, the demo-antigravity corpus yields eight resolved edges, proving cross-kind slash resolution end to end.
